description: Autopilot AI orchestration — describe your intent, orchex auto-generates a plan, parallelizes it into streams with file ownership enforcement, self-heals failures, and routes across 6 LLM providers. Supports Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Ollama, and AWS Bedrock.
